hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && case "$(basename "$f")" in *.bak.*) ;; .env|.env.*) [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; cp "$f" "$f.bak.$(date +%s)" || echo "[env-backup] FAILED to back up $f -- do not edit it until you know why" >&2 ;; esac; }; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'pm2 restart' && echo "$cmd" | grep -q -- '--update-env'; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "pm2 restart --update-env does not re-evaluate ecosystem.config.cjs. Use: pm2 startOrRestart ecosystem.config.cjs with fresh env. See memory/feedback_pm2_env_management.md and feedback_env_xargs_export_breaks_on_comments.md (cat .env | xargs breaks on comments)."}}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(>>?[[:space:]]*[^|;&]*\.env([.][A-Za-z0-9_-]+)?([[:space:]]|$)|sed[[:space:]][^|;&]*-i[^|;&]*\.env|tee[[:space:]][^|;&]*\.env|(cp|mv)[[:space:]][^|;&]*[[:space:]][^|;&]*\.env([.][A-Za-z0-9_-]+)?([[:space:]]|$))'; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Writing a .env file through Bash skips the PreToolUse backup and the duplicate-key check, which only match Edit|Write. Use the Edit or Write tool so the .bak snapshot and env-duplicate-check.sh run. If this really must be a shell write, say so and it can be approved explicitly."}}'; fi
